method.source_state: post-update Tongji 11D EKF state while tracker_state=tracking
method.rollout: constant center velocity, constant yaw rate, fixed radii and heights
method.armor_correspondence: nearest decoded EKF candidate to the same-exposure truth-matched physical armor; the correspondence is held for the future horizon
method.future_truth: later recorded exposure truth, linearly interpolated only when the bracketing gap is <= 25 ms
method.normal_radial_definition: horizontal target-center-to-armor axis; this is also the armor normal in the Z4 model
method.vertical_definition: tracker +z, lying in the armor plane
method.window_definition: valid-sample geometric coverage: abs(tangential) <= half width and abs(vertical) <= half height
